screens.title: Ersteinrichtung — Softwareschmiede Status
screens.prompt:
Create the first-time administrative setup page ("Ersteinrichtung") for the internal operations tool "Softwareschmiede Status", perfectly harmonizing with the existing login screen layout and design system {{DATA:DESIGN_SYSTEM:DESIGN_SYSTEM_1}}.

Layout & Theme:
- Desktop view, centered card layout on the quiet engineering grid/subtle background canvas (matching the login screen style of Softwareschmiede Status).
- Brand header above the card: Softwareschmiede logo badge icon (code/terminal screen icon in vibrant blue `#2563eb`), title "Softwareschmiede" with badge "STATUS" next to it, and subtitle "OPERATIONS CONTROL & MONITORING" or "INITIAL SETUP & SYSTEM CONFIGURATION". Top-right indicator "INTERNES ADMIN-PORTAL" with lock icon.

Card Content:
- Badge / Setup indicator at the top of the card: "SETUP 1/1" or "ERSTEINRICHTUNG" with a subtle shield/key icon.
- Heading: "Ersteinrichtung"
- Explanatory text under the title: "Es ist noch kein Benutzerkonto vorhanden. Legen Sie jetzt das Administratorkonto an."
- Form fields:
  1. "Benutzername" (Label with small helper "ADMINISTRATOR" or "SSO / LOKAL"), input field with an `@` or user icon prefix, default/placeholder like "admin" or "admin@softwareschmiede.internal".
  2. "Passwort" (Label with helper "SCHLÜSSEL / SICHERHEIT"), input field for password with key icon prefix and an eye toggle icon for visibility, plus directly under the input field the hint: "Mindestens 12 Zeichen — Buchstaben, Ziffern und Sonderzeichen erlaubt" (styled cleanly with a small info icon or subtle text in muted tone). Include a modern password strength meter/indicator (e.g. 4 small bars or progress bar indicating strong security).
  3. "Passwort wiederholen" (Label), input field for password confirmation with key icon prefix and matching status check indicator.
- Primary CTA button: Full-width blue action button "Konto anlegen" with an appropriate forward or check/user-plus icon (`→` or user-check icon).
- Subtle Info note box below or inside the card: "Diese Seite ist nur erreichbar, solange kein Konto existiert." with a subtle info/lock badge in a soft blue/slate container.

Footer & Security Indicators:
- Below card: "Ende-zu-Ende verschlüsselte Verbindung • TLS 1.3 • v2.4.1" and system status / version footer identical in tone and style to the login screen.
- High precision, clean borders, crisp typography (Inter), rounded corners matching `round_four`, German language everywhere.

designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

This design system targets technical leads, sysadmins, and site reliability engineers operating mission-critical environments. The visual language conveys operational clarity, uncompromising stability, and high data utility. 

Key attributes:
- **Style Archetype:** Modern Corporate Engineering / Data-Dense Utility.
- **Aesthetic Tenets:** Information over decoration, zero layout ambiguity, surgical contrast, and structural rhythm.
- **Visual Personality:** Quiet, restrained, objective, and responsive. Surfaces operate as quiet scaffolding while system states take center stage.

## Layout & Spacing

The dashboard uses a structured fluid grid combined with modular layout panes:

- **Desktop (1024px+):** Collapsible persistent left navigation bar (240px fixed), fluid workspace spanning 12 columns with `1.5rem` gutters. Maximum canvas bounds cap at `1600px` for ultra-wide displays to maintain glanceability.
- **Tablet (768px - 1023px):** 8-column layout, left navigation reduces to an icon-only dock (64px), horizontal canvas margin at `1.5rem`.
- **Mobile (<768px):** 4-column layout with `1rem` margin and `1rem` gutter. Complex health tables convert to vertically stacked cards.

Vertical spacing operates on an absolute 4px base increment (`0.25rem`, `0.5rem`, `0.75rem`, `1rem`, `1.5rem`) to ensure tight component padding without dead space.

## Elevation & Depth

To avoid visual noise across dense dashboards, this system relies on low-contrast structural outlines rather than heavy drop shadows:

- **Level 0 (App Canvas):** Fills `#F8FAFC`. Zero elevation, zero shadows.
- **Level 1 (Card & Module Containers):** Surface `#FFFFFF`, bordered with a 1px solid `#E2E8F0`. Shadow: `0 1px 2px 0 rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04)`.
- **Level 2 (Dropdowns, Popovers, Filter Menus):** Surface `#FFFFFF`, bordered with 1px solid `#CBD5E1`. Shadow: `0 4px 6px -1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05)`.
- **Level 3 (Modal Dialogs & Critical Incident Overlays):** Surface `#FFFFFF`, borderless with full-bleed scrim (`rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.45)`). Shadow: `0 20px 25px -5px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08)`.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary:** Solid `#2563EB` fill, white `#FFFFFF` text, `0.25rem` radius, `0.5rem 0.875rem` padding. Subtle brightness decrease on hover (`#1D4ED8`). Focus ring: 2px offset with `#93C5FD`.
- **Secondary:** White `#FFFFFF` fill, 1px `#E2E8F0` border, `#0F172A` text. Hover state switches background to `#F8FAFC`.
- **Destructive/Action:** `#DC2626` fill or transparent with `#DC2626` text for secondary destructive triggers.

### Status Badges & Pills
- **Geometry:** Height 22px, padding `0 0.5rem`, font `JetBrains Mono` (`code-sm`), weight 500.
- **Healthy:** `#DCFCE7` background, `#16A34A` text, `#BBF7D0` 1px border. Accompanied by a 6px solid green dot.
- **Warning ("Teilweise veraltet"):** `#FEF3C7` background, `#D97706` text, `#FDE68A` 1px border. Accompanied by a 6px warning amber dot.
- **Critical / Fetch Error:** `#FEE2E2` background, `#DC2626` text, `#FECACA` 1px border. Accompanied by a 6px pulsing red dot.

### Data Tables & Service Lists
- **Headers:** Surface `#F8FAFC`, bottom border 1px `#E2E8F0`, uppercase text in `#475569`, tracking `0.05em`, size `0.6875rem`.
- **Rows:** White `#FFFFFF` background, 1px bottom border `#F1F5F9`. Height fixed at 44px for high density.
- **Hover State:** Row background transitions to `#F8FAFC` instantly without motion delays.

### Input Fields & Search Bars
- **Frame:** Height 36px, `0.25rem` radius, 1px border `#E2E8F0`, background `#FFFFFF`.
- **Focus:** 1px border `#2563EB`, box-shadow `0 0 0 1px #2563EB`.
- **Monospace Input:** Used specifically for token filters and Git revision queries using `code-md`.

### Cards & Metrics
- **Metric Cards:** `#FFFFFF` background, 1px `#E2E8F0` border, `1rem` internal padding. Key metric in `headline-lg` (`#0F172A`), subtitle in `body-sm` (`#475569`), status badge positioned top-right.
- **Dividers:** Clean 1px `#E2E8F0` rules. Never use double borders or styled drop-lines.

outputComponents.text:
Ich habe die Seite **„Ersteinrichtung“** für das interne Überwachungstool **„Softwareschmiede Status“** erstellt.

### Wichtige Design- und Funktionsentscheidungen:
- **Visuelle Kontinuität:** Das Design knüpft nahtlos an die bestehende Anmeldeseite und das Design-System an – mit dem charakteristischen technischen Hintergrundraster, dem minimalistischen blauen Branding und den Sicherheits-Badges.
- **Zentrierte Kartenstruktur:** Eine fokussierte, ruhige Setup-Karte mit Statusanzeigen („Schritt 1 / 1 • Ersteinrichtung“, „Bootstrap Modus aktiv“).
- **Formular & Validierung:**
  - **Benutzername:** Vorbelegt mit `admin` für die Erstellung des Root-Administratorkontos.
  - **Passwort:** Inklusive Sicherheitsstufen-Balken, Passwort-Sichtbarkeitsumschalter und dem Hinweis *„Mindestens 12 Zeichen — Buchstaben, Ziffern und Sonderzeichen erlaubt“*.
  - **Passwort wiederholen:** Abgleichsfeld zur Bestätigung.
- **Primärer Call-to-Action:** Hervorgehobener Button **„Konto anlegen“** mit Icon.
- **Sicherheitshinweis:** Dezente Infobox mit dem Hinweis: *„Diese Seite ist nur erreichbar, solange noch kein Administratorkonto im Identitätsspeicher persistiert wurde. Sobald das Konto erzeugt ist, wird dieser Setup-Endpoint permanent deaktiviert.“*
- **Footer & Metadaten:** Sicherheitsangaben zu Verschlüsselung (TLS 1.3, SHA-256) und Betriebsstatus im Einklang mit der Tool-Suite.
